FDM is an award-winning global business and technology consultancy powering the people behind tech and innovation for over 30 years. They collaborate with world-leading companies to identify the expertise they need, exactly when they need it. 

They have helped successfully launch nearly 25,000 careers globally to date and are a trusted partner to over 300 companies worldwide.  

FDM has 2500+ employees worldwide, with over 80 nationalities working together as a team. From their origins in Brighton, UK, FDM now has 19 centres located across Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific and is on the FTSE4Good Index.
Powering the people behind tech and innovation

At FDM, diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our ethos, fostering equity and driving business success. We champion diversity in all its forms, including gender, ethnicity, neurodiversity, and LGBTQIA+. We also strongly support parental and caring responsibilities.

We recognise that each employee has a unique identity and celebrate these differences. We are continually striving to create a workplace where our employees feel safe, have the opportunity to thrive and are encouraged to be their true selves.

Our purpose is to help people forge long-term careers whilst driving diversity, equity and inclusion. FDM’s inclusive careers programmes aim to ensure that everyone begins their professional life on an equal footing.

recentJobs.jobDescription: About The Role FDM is a global business and technology consultancy seeking an experienced Programme Manager to support in the delivery of a major portfolio of infrastructure projects. You will play a key role in leading the successful delivery of active travel programmes across the Leeds region, supporting city-wide regeneration, sustainable transport, and public realm improvement initiatives. Working in a client-side environment, you will collaborate with local authorities, delivery partners, contractors, and senior public sector stakeholders to deliver projects that encourage walking, cycling, equestrian access, and wider non-motorised transport options. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to high-profile public sector infrastructure programmes that will have a lasting impact on sustainable travel, regional connectivity, public health, and economic growth across West Yorkshire. This contract runs initially until March 2027, with the potential for extension. The role requires attendance within the Leeds and West Yorkshire area approximately one day per week, with the remainder of the time working remotely. We are seeking an experienced Programme Manager with a strong active travel and sustainable transport background to oversee a portfolio of construction and infrastructure projects delivered under the Transforming Cities Fund programme. You will be responsible for coordinating multiple projects simultaneously, managing stakeholder relationships, overseeing programme governance, and ensuring the successful delivery of active travel investment initiatives. Working closely with local authorities, engineers, contractors, transport planners, and senior leaders, you will provide programme leadership across a diverse range of cycling, walking, equestrian, and non-motorised user schemes. The role requires exceptional stakeholder management, programme governance, and delivery leadership capabilities. You will act as a trusted client-side representative, ensuring delivery partners successfully implement projects that support wider sustainable transport and regeneration objectives. Responsibilities: Leading the delivery of multiple concurrent active travel and sustainable transport projects Providing programme oversight for cycling, walking, equestrian, and non-motorised user infrastructure schemes Managing programme governance, reporting, and assurance activities across multiple projects Developing and maintaining programme delivery plans, schedules, and performance About The Role FDM is a global business and technology consultancy seeking an Interim Head of DevOps to work for our client within the public sector. This is initially a 6 month contract and will be a hybrid role that will be based UK-wide from a local hub, with weekly attendance at a local office. Our client is seeking an experienced senior technology leader to provide strategic direction across a multidisciplinary digital development capability covering Dynamics 365, software and web development, quality assurance, testing, Azure DevOps and digital service support. The successful candidate will play a key role in strengthening delivery accountability, supporting major transformation initiatives and aligning technical teams with organisational priorities. This role offers the opportunity to shape both immediate delivery outcomes and the longer-term direction of a significant digital development function. Responsibilities: Lead and provide strategic direction across multidisciplinary digital development, DevOps and service support teams. Take overall accountability for technical delivery across key digital projects, programmes and live services. Establish clear ownership, delivery expectations and effective ways of working across the development function. Support priority programmes, live services and FinOps initiatives while addressing delivery risks and challenges. Collaborate with senior stakeholders to ensure technical delivery remains aligned with wider programme and organisational objectives. About You Significant experience leading multidisciplinary software development, DevOps or digital delivery teams at a senior level. Proven experience delivering change, transformation, project or programme initiatives within complex environments. Strong knowledge of software delivery and modern engineering practices, with sufficient technical depth to challenge decisions and support delivery teams. Experience holding technical teams accountable for delivery, quality and business outcomes while influencing senior stakeholders. Desirable: Experience with Azure cloud environments, Azure DevOps, Dynamics 365 development teams, digital service support or FinOps capability. About The Role FDM is a global business and technology consultancy seeking Business Analysts to work with our global systems integrator client on a major Central Government Service Transformation Programme. About The Role FDM is a global business and technology consultancy seeking experienced Project Managers to support a rail infrastructure client in the successful close-out and handover of depot-focused projects within the Crewe and Holgate/York areas. You will play a key role in bringing a portfolio of infrastructure and depot-related schemes through their final stages of delivery, ensuring all activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with programme governance requirements. Working within a complex rail environment, you will collaborate with operational teams, contractors, engineers, commercial teams, and senior stakeholders to manage project closure, handover, assurance, and final delivery activities. The role will require regular site attendance within the Crewe and Holgate areas, typically two days per week, with the remainder of the time spent working remotely. About the Role We are seeking Scheme Project Managers with rail infrastructure and depot delivery experience to support the close-out, completion, and handover of a number of active schemes. You will be responsible for overseeing the final phases of project delivery, ensuring all outstanding works, governance requirements, commercial activities, documentation, and operational handovers are completed successfully. Working closely with delivery teams, asset managers, operational stakeholders, contractors, and support functions, you will ensure projects are closed in a controlled and compliant manner. The role requires strong project governance, stakeholder management, commercial awareness, health and safety knowledge, and experience operating within project environments. You will act as a key link between project delivery and operational teams, ensuring successful transition into business-as-usual operations. Responsibilities: Managing the close-out and handover activities for multiple depot-focused infrastructure projects Coordinating final delivery activities to ensure successful transition into operations Developing and maintaining project plans, schedules, and delivery programmes Managing project governance, reporting, assurance, and project controls processes Overseeing project risks, issues, actions, and dependencies through to completion Supporting contract administration and commercial management activities Monitoring project performance against scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives Ensuring compliance with health and safety legislation, standards, and best practice Coordinating contractors, technical specialists, operational teams, and key stakeholders Producing project reports, completion documentation, and handover packs Facilitating stakeholder meetings, progress reviews, and governance forums Managing relationships with customers, third-party representatives, business leaders, and support functions Supporting investment, procurement, and governance requirements throughout project closure Leading project teams and providing effective line
